title: Mike Miner
body:
Mike Miner is a NPC in Oaklands, and the proprietor of Mike's Mines.

Description

Prior to the map revamp, Mike Miner had a small shop on the far side of Finlay Island. He sold low-grade explosives, Lanterns, and Miner's Lamps. His wife had gone missing, and the man had been left dejected.

In the current version of the map, Mike Miner runs a shop out of a shack at the entrance to his self-named mines. These mines run deep beneath the earth. The shop itself sells the same low-grade explosives as before, though Mike himself is far more upbeat. Mike speaks with a stereotypical "cowboy" accent. He is accompanied by his wife Jenna, who stands outside the shack.
